routes.name: Gengis Bond
routes.desc: Great 3D climbing with good rests up a series of stalactite features. It's long, make sure you have enough rope and tie a knot in the end of your rope. 13 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Tongue Thaid
routes.desc: Climb as one pitch. 1. 6 titanium bolts, 2 slings 2. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling

routes.name: Lom Mon / Cyclone
routes.desc: Watch out for the crux - photo says it all... Beautiful long run afterwards. 11 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Bottom Feeder
routes.desc: 6b for 5 bolts to the first anchor. Two more bolts to second anchor. 7 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Nut Cracker
routes.desc: Great technical face climb with multiple small cruxes. 6 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Aspirin
routes.desc: The left of the two climbs that start off the boulder. Face climbing follows some fun tufa action. Medusa's lover is the route on the right. 10 titanium bolts, 1 sling.
routes.setter: Björn Alber, Nantawan Alber & Robert Baier, 2006

routes.name: Medusa's Lover
routes.desc: Sharp start leads to an interesting mid section. Starts on top of the big boulder. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Babo Does Thailand
routes.desc: The best line at 'The Keep'. Not hard but stella climbing the whole way. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Monkey's Bum
routes.desc: First climb as you enter 'The Keep'. Move up slimy tufas, then continue up. Awful anchor placement. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings.
